question: I am closing my business. How do I dissolve the company and cancel its registration?

nuggets.text: An LLC is dissolved on the events the statute lists, including the members' consent.
nuggets.quote: (a) A limited liability company is dissolved, and its activities and affairs shall be wound up, upon the occurrence of any of the following: (1) An event or circumstance that the operating agreement states causes dissolution;

nuggets.text: After dissolution the company may deliver a statement of dissolution to the Mayor for filing.
nuggets.quote: and (B) Deliver to the Mayor for filing a statement of dissolution stating the name of the company and that the company is dissolved; and (2) May: (A) Preserve the company activities and affairs and property as a going concern for a reasonable time
